last.verdict: MetLife posted a record quarter, but a 49% jump in volatile investment income did much of the work.

takeaways.label: Record earnings
takeaways.text: Adjusted earnings per share rose 22% to $2.85 excluding one-time items ($2.78 including them), the highest in MetLife's history. Return on equity was 19.6%.

takeaways.label: Investment income boost
takeaways.text: Variable investment income, which swings with markets and is less repeatable, rose 49% to $720 million. It was the main driver of the 12% earnings gain.

takeaways.label: Broad growth, uneven profit
takeaways.text: Revenue rose in all six segments, up 8% to $13.5 billion excluding pension deals. Europe, the Middle East and Africa rose 30% on volume, but Latin America fell 5% at constant exchange rates.

takeaways.label: Asia sales slipped
takeaways.text: Asia sales fell 6% at constant exchange rates against a strong prior-year quarter. They are still up 10% year to date.

history.verdict: Investors cheered a clear profit beat driven by better insurance claims results.

reasons.label: Earnings beat
reasons.text: Adjusted earnings of $2.43 per share topped analyst estimates of about $2.29.

reasons.label: Better claims results
reasons.text: Group Benefits profit jumped 25% to $503 million on favorable underwriting and volume growth.

reasons.label: Broad growth, high returns
reasons.text: Every segment grew; return on equity hit 17% for a second straight quarter.
